spriteSize.note: Launch copy +0 (outside the DB copy). Passed as the 4th arg (collision mask / radius index) of ConstructCGameTask in the CTaskMissile ctor. Bazooka/grenade 2; PX clustlet reset uses 2.

launchSpeed.note: Fixed shot power in percent; 0 = use player charge. Vanilla: Mortar 100, Pigeon 33, Sheep Launcher 50, all others 0. PX clustlet script sets 0.

runAway.note: Worm 'run away' shout 800 ms before the blast (missile +0x164 compared/set in the frame handler). 1 for Grenade/Cluster/Banana, 0 for Bazooka. PX clustlet script sets true.

explosion.flags.note: Bitfield; DB+0 (missile +0x2d4). OR-ed into object collision flags and tested in the collide function (0x508c90). 137342 for Bazooka/clustlets, 0 for Grenade, 0x400000 = skim only, 1 in pyro scripts. Treat as int.

explosion.bias.note: DB+4 (+0x2d8). 4th arg of CreateExplosion/DoExplosion ('unkB'). 0 in every vanilla weapon checked; PX scripts set 0. Argument order fixed by the explosion call at 0x509b05..0x509b38.

explosion.pushPower.note: DB+8 (+0x2dc). Percent. 100 in Bazooka/clustlets; PX script 100.

explosion.damage.note: DB+0xC (+0x2e0). Bazooka 50, Grenade 50, Mortar 30, Cluster/Banana clustlets 30/75; PX scripts override (20/60). Read at 0x509aee/0x509b12 together with dmgVar (damage-variance function 0x547cb0).

explosion.dmgVar.note: DB+0x10 (+0x2e4). Damage variance percent; consumed by 0x547cb0 at 0x509ae8. 0 in the vanilla weapons checked; PX airplane script 0.

unk.note: DB+0x14 (+0x2e8). Divisor in the ctor: spriteIndex += (ShootDesc+0x20 - 1) % unk, i.e. number of sprite variants cycled across clustlets. 1 in vanilla clustlet blocks, 0 in plain block A. Keep name 'unk'.

anim.spriteIndex.note: DB+0x18 (+0x2ec). Sprite id. Bazooka 48, Mortar 52, Banana clustlet 51, Cluster clustlet 54 (matches PX clustlet reset 54). Used by the missile render (0x5091a0).

anim.type.note: Offset certain (render switch at 0x5094ba, frame handler at 0x50b6aa, vanilla clustlet = 1 = WAT_Rotation). Raw values: 0 fuse-progress frame (frame = 1 - timer/countdown); 1 spin/rotation ([obj+0x8c] angle, [obj+0x98] spin; grenades, clusters, banana, homing); 2 face direction of travel (bazooka, mortar, sheep launcher); 3 speed-dependent frame offset with horizontal flip (pigeon, min(|vx|/2,3)); 4/5/6 frame advance each tick by [obj+0x128]/100, /50, /25 (slow/medium/fast; sheep family = 6). Name mapping: Rotation=1 (high), TrackMovement=2 (med-high), HSpeed=3 (med), Slow=4 / Medium=5 / Fast=6 (med-high), TrackSpeed=0 only by elimination (low). The existing pxrt_e_consts.lua WAT values (TrackMovement=0, Fast=1, TrackSpeed=2, Slow=3, Medium=4, Rotation=5, HSpeed=6) contradict the code.

anim.trailIndex.note: DB+0x20 (+0x2f4). Trail sprite id, 131 in vanilla and PX scripts. Base of the trail block read via edi=&+0x2f4 at 0x50ba79.

anim.trailPower.note: DB+0x24 (+0x2f8). Trail puff spawn rate (accumulated each frame into [+0x114]). Bazooka 50, clustlets 20 (PX reset 20), banana clustlet 0.

anim.trailSpeed.note: DB+0x28 (+0x2fc). Puff speed/scale argument (x 0x147a / 100). 100 everywhere vanilla; PX script 100.

anim.unk.note: DB+0x2C (+0x300). Rate of underwater bubble puffs: used by the branch at 0x50bb8a taken when missile Y >= water level (spawns via 0x5472c0). 50 in all vanilla weapons except weapon 25 (200). PX script 50.

speedMultipler.note: DB+0x30 (+0x304). Percent speed scale, 100 default; read in init at 0x50817c.

windFactor.note: DB+0x34 (+0x308), copied to CGObject +0x5c (WindFactor). Bazooka 100, Grenade/clustlets 0.

gravityFactor.note: DB+0x3C (+0x310), copied to CGObject +0x60 (GravityFactor). 100 default, PX airplane 0.

countdownFrom.note: DB+0x40 (+0x314), ms. Fuse start for fused projectiles (Grenade/Cluster/Banana 5000), 0 for rocket types. Compared in the render at 0x509269 (fuse label).

timeBeforeExplosion.note: DB+0x44 (+0x318), ms; entry +0x8C. Max lifetime (Bazooka 9000, Homing 10000, clustlets 9000, PX reset 10000); overwritten from ShootDesc+0x28 at ctor 0x507f1c when nonzero. Also the divisor of the anim.type 0 frame.

sound.soundIndex.note: DB+0x48 (+0x31c). Looped in-flight sound started in the ctor (0x508ab1 -> 0x546c20, handle in +0x3e4). 66 in PX nuke/oil-drum scripts, 0 in vanilla clustlets.

sound.useExpSound.note: DB+0x4C (+0x320). Gate for the delayed explosion sound: when set, the countdown at 0x50b868 only runs while the object is NOT moving (0x4fb580 false). Holy Hand Grenade = 1.

sound.expSoundIndex.note: DB+0x50 (+0x324). Sound played by PlaySoundLocal at 0x50b8a8 when the delay counter [+0x380] expires. Holy Hand Grenade 104.

sound.expSoundDelay.note: DB+0x54 (+0x328), ms. Copied into the counter [+0x380] at ctor 0x507fb8; counter drops 20 per frame. Holy Hand Grenade 1800.

explodeOnSpace.note: DB+0x58 (+0x32c). Nonzero = missile reacts to the 'fire again' message 0x2c (HandleMessage 0x50b4e0 -> 0x50b557): value 1 detonates (SetState 1, or SetState 2 if explodeInto==3), value 2 re-arms (clears +0x314/+0x32c, random +0x37c). Vanilla 1 on sheep family and Sheep Launcher. Not exercised at runtime.

action.note: DB+0x5C (+0x330) = CMissile.ActionType. Offset certain. Raw values from the ctor/frame/water/collision switches: 0 none (valid, no special handling), 1 homing (Homing Missile, Pigeon), 2 ballistic with bounce% (Bazooka, Mortar, Grenade, clusters, banana, clustlets), 3 walker/sheep (turns at walls, crate pickup, sheep family), 4 jump-and-animate walker (unused in the vanilla table; 3-sprite cycle), 5 Sheep Launcher (ballistic like 2 plus launcher logic). PX name mapping is NOT verifiable from the exe: best guess None=0, Homing=1, Bounce=2, Roam=3 (med), Dig=4 (low). pxrt_e_consts.lua (Bounce=1, Homing=2, Dig=3) is almost certainly wrong.

explodeInto.note: Launch copy +0xB4 (outside DB; +0x210). Explode-time switch at 0x509b43: 0 nothing, 1 clustlets (0x5096a0, first explosion only), 2 fire/napalm (0x509d70), 3 clustlet variant (same path as 1; also forces SetState 2 on fire-again). Matches WExplode_Nothing=0, Clustlets=1, Fire=2.

wav.note: UNRESOLVED. No script in the corpus reads or writes a launch 'wav'. Only candidate: launch copy +0xB8, a sound id played once at missile creation (PlaySoundGlobal at 0x507eab, block-A path only; Pigeon 51, Sheep Launcher 50). Do not rely on it.

movementRandomness.note: DB+0x38 (+0x30c). Random jitter applied to velocity in the frame handler (0x50b72f..0x50b75e).

collisionFlags.note: DB+0x60 (+0x334). OR-ed with explosion.flags into CGObject +0x34 at ctor (0x508273/0x508284); bit 0x40000000 tested at 0x50b24c. 0x400000 Bazooka/Mortar, 0x42187e sheep family.

bounce.note: +0x338. Bounciness percent for action 2/5, copied to CGObject +0x70 (DumpingB) as value/100. 0 = use the player-set bounce (ShootDesc+0x24, M_SETBOUNCE). Banana 60, Pigeon 58, Mortar 1.

friction.note: +0x33c. Percent scaled by the game friction setting (game+0xd780/0xd784), stored to CGObject +0x74. Grenade/Cluster/Banana 100.

launchSound.note: Same slot as the unresolved 'wav' candidate: sound id played once at creation.

childCount.note: Launch copy +0xBC (+0x218). Number of clustlets / fire particles spawned on explosion (loop at 0x509735). Mortar/Cluster/Banana 5, Napalm-type 40.

childSpeedVar.note: +0x220. Multiplies childSpeed; random variation percent (30 vanilla).

childSpread.note: +0x228. Random angle spread in degrees (45 vanilla), used as (rand-0.5)*value*256/360.
